_comment: GOLDEN CASES — operator-authored ground truth for cap enforcement (create_item, move_item, set_item_state, swap_move). PROPOSED (not yet frozen). Once frozen, editing requires SPEC: tag + operator action per AUTONOMY_CHARTER §12. These pin the doctrine: A=5, B=12, caps apply to active-only (blocked/done exempt), Inbox/C unbounded.

cases.name: A cap: 5 active allowed, 6th rejected with CAP_EXCEEDED
B cap: 12 active allowed, 13th rejected with CAP_EXCEEDED
blocked item doesn't count: 5 active + 1 blocked in A, 6th active create rejected
cases._corrected: 2026-07-26 (P5a golden runner): the original ops blocked one of 5 A items and expected the very next create to CAP_EXCEEDED with a_active_after=4 — internally inconsistent with the case's own name ('5 active + 1 blocked') and with doctrine ('blocked does not count'; 4 active < cap, the create MUST succeed). Corrected ops create the 5th active AFTER the block (succeeds), then attempt a 6th active (fails). Still _status:proposed — operator review + freeze requested.

cases.name: done item doesn't count: 5 active + 1 done in A, 6th active create rejected
cases._corrected: 2026-07-26 (P5a golden runner): same defect class as the blocked case — original expected the create AFTER marking one done to fail at 4 active, contradicting 'done does not count'. Corrected: 5th active create succeeds, 6th fails.

cases.name: done->active undo at cap rejected: A full of active, mark one done, mark another done, undo the first -> still at cap
done->active undo refills slot: A full, mark one done (frees slot), create 6th (fills slot), undo the done -> CAP_EXCEEDED
cases._corrected: 2026-07-26 (P5a golden runner): original expected a_done_after=0, but the done->active transition FAILS (CAP_EXCEEDED), so a0 must REMAIN done — a failed transition cannot mutate state. a_done_after=1.

cases.name: cross-tier move into full A rejected: 5 active in A, move active B item to A -> CAP_EXCEEDED
cross-tier move of blocked item into full A allowed: blocked doesn't count
swap into full A: one in one out, active count preserved
restore into full A rejected: soft-deleted A item, A refilled, restore -> CAP_EXCEEDED
